journal_lines: Chert nodules in the limestone. Useful.
Flint strikes well. Kept the best pieces.
Black knots in the white limestone, like old eyes in a tired face.
Flint old enough to remember the riverbed it came from.
A handful of chips, sharp as winter. Wrapped them carefully.
Old stone, useful stone. Some things do not need to be rare.
Struck two together. Got a spark. The cave got a moment of light.
Picked them out by feel. The shape is unmistakable.
Flint cuts. Flint does not apologize for cutting.
Took the best, left the rest for the river to find again.
